svg.title: Major insignia, on the 2 in OCP square
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-senior-major-ocp-square","name":"Major insignia, on the 2 in OCP square","size_in":{"w":2,"h":2},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,200,200],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Largest dimension 1 in (DAFI 36-2903 7.1.5.1 \"1-inch metal rank insignia\"); outline measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-2 (leaf is 0.90 in wide at 1 in tall)","anchors":{"top_center":[100,0],"bottom_center":[100,200],"center":[100,100],"left_edge":[0,100],"right_edge":[200,100],"insignia_center":[100,100]},"dimensions":{"form":"on the 2 in OCP square","insignia_w_in":0.9004,"insignia_h_in":1,"square_in":2,"fits_inside_square":true,"shape":"oak leaf","stem":"toward the ground (OCP, 7.1.1.2.1)","thread":"gold"},"estimated":"Outline vertices and vein hub read from the figure (about 90 px across in the source); mirror-symmetrised. Veins are simplified to hub-to-tip lines.","mounts":[{"uniform":"OCP coat","rule":"2 in x 2 in dark blue square, center of chest. Generals: stars 1 in (3/4 in if unable), stacked vertically, one point up each; Colonel eagle centered horizontally, beak toward the wearer's right shoulder (viewer's left); Major / Lt Col stem toward the ground; Flight Officer / Lt / Capt bars with the long end vertical (7.1.1.2.1). Asset baseline = this orientation, rotation 0.","placement":{"rotate_deg":0}},{"uniform":"green / black fleece (front)","rule":"dark blue material on the front: generals positioned HORIZONTALLY with one point of each star up (use the -horizontal form); Colonel centered horizontally, beak toward the wearer's right shoulder; Major / Lt Col stem toward the ground; bars long end vertical (6.1.10.2.1, 6.1.14.4.1)","placement":{"rotate_deg":0}},{"uniform":"ABU / BDU / blue field coat collar","rule":"light silver on dark blue cloth (2d Lt and Major gold), 1/8 in of blue showing past the widest and tallest point, centered 1 in from the bottom of the collar. Generals: stars centered, perpendicular to the collar (use the -horizontal form); Colonel centered, perpendicular to the collar, eagle facing forward; Lt Col / Major: stem parallel to the ground pointing AWAY from the wearer's neck = rotate the asset 90 degrees (+90 cw on the wearer's right collar so the stem points to the viewer's left, -90 on the left collar); Flight Officer / Lt / Capt: long end centered (5.1.1.1.1.1, 5.1.2.2.1, 5.2.1.1.1.1)","placement":{"rotate_deg_by_grade":{"major":90,"lieutenant-colonel":90},"note":"+90 = clockwise on the wearer's right collar; mirror the rotation (-90) on the left collar; other grades 0"}},{"uniform":"OCP / ABU / BDU / blue field / navy tactical cap (front)","rule":"officers only (NCOs wear none, 7.1.1.8, 6.2.11.1): rank sewn or Velcro, centered 1/2 in from the visor (patrol/tactical OCP 7.1.1.8; ABU 5.1.1.2; blue field cap 5.2.1.1.1.2), only 1/8 in of blue showing past the widest and tallest point; silver on dark blue, 2d Lt and Major gold (6.2.11.1)","placement":{"rotate_deg":0}},{"uniform":"USAF-style flight duty uniform (FDU) / green flight jacket","rule":"cloth-bordered form: dark blue cloth with silver or gold embroidery replaces the plastic-encased grade. Officers: centered on top of each shoulder, bottom edge of the insignia 1/2 in from the shoulder seam (8.2.3.2). Generals: 1 in stars (3/4 in optional) centered on the shoulder halfway between neck and shoulder seam (8.2.3.1). NCOs and cadets wear none (8.2.3.3).","placement":{"rotate_deg":0}},{"uniform":"Corporate flight duty uniform (CFDU)","rule":"plastic-encased or full-color grade embroidered on dark blue background, same placement as the FDU (8.3.3.2); NCOs and cadets: none (8.3.3.3)","placement":{"rotate_deg":0}},{"uniform":"Class A service coat (with epaulets), Class B blue shirt / blouse, corporate aviator shirt, jackets","rule":"officers: embroidered grade on the slip-on gray epaulet sleeve, see rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-*; Colonel eagle beak facing forward; Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar; bars lie across the sleeve (4.1.5.2.1.1, 4.1.6.1.1-2, 4.1.1.1.1.3, 4.2.5.1.1.1-2)","placement":{"via":"rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-*","anchor":{"single_forms":"garment anchor rank_rule_point_left/right (Class B, mess) or rank_rule_point_left_center/right_center (Class A coat): 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 4.5.1.1.1); the slot container is 2.3 in along the strap and its centre sits about 0.6 in inboard of that point","multi_star_generals":"garment rank_slot_*_center (Brig Gen single star at the rule point; Maj Gen pair stacked along the strap at the slot centre)"},"when_placing_a_loose_piece_in_a_garment_rank_slot":"rotate so the Major / Lt Col stem points along the strap toward the arm end: rotate_deg = strap_angle_deg - 90 (strap angle measured from +x toward +y, about 14 deg on the Class A coat, 21 deg on the Class B shirt); bars lie across the strap: rotate_deg = strap_angle_deg; Colonel: regulation says only \"beak facing forward\" (4.1.6.1.2); the asset is drawn beak toward the viewer's left, keep it unrotated"}},{"uniform":"Mess dress shoulder boards","rule":"bullion grade on the board with 1/2 in dark blue braid down each side, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; Colonel beak forward; Lt Col / Major stem away from the collar (4.1.1.1.1.1-3, 4.1.2.1.1.1-3). Use rank-senior-<grade>-bullion (build-mess-dress-grade.js).","placement":{"rotate_deg":0,"via":"rank-senior-<grade>-bullion"}},{"uniform":"Corporate blazer","rule":"no epaulet sleeve; optional grade on the blazer nameplate for officers and NCOs, not for cadets (4.2.3.1.1.2, 4.2.4.1.1.2)"}],"cloth_color":{"hex":"#142347","basis":"sampled from CAPR 39-1 p.136 cloth figure"},"rank":{"grade":"Major","abbrev":"Maj","membership":"senior"},"grade":"rank-insignia"}
